Lorrdians of conscience have an obligation to seek out this practice, whatever its guise, and to end it, whatever the cost.|Salis Kabor|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
'''Salis Kabor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] revolutionary, who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Kabor tried to stop [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] from being practiced and was the instigator of the [[Kessel revolts]]. He later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and tried to unite the various Alliance groups that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].
